title: AI 协作用户认知测评

start_items.text_zh: 请选择问卷与生成内容的语言：
start_items.text_en: Choose your language for the questionnaire and generated profile:

en.title: AI Collaboration User Assessment
en.subtitle: A ~60-item questionnaire on a 5-point scale. Takes about 8–10 minutes.
en.lang_question: Select the language for this questionnaire and your profile:
en.ext_placeholder: e.g. tools you use, projects you work on, situations where AI should behave differently…
en.subtitle_zh: 共 60 题 · 打分题 1-5（1 完全不同意 → 5 完全同意）· 其余 是/否 · 预计 8-10 分钟

dimensions.name: 粒度
dimensions.question: 先框架还是先深入？回复详尽还是简洁？

dimensions.name: 主动性
dimensions.question: 主动建议还是只做交代的事？

dimensions.name: 角色定位
dimensions.question: AI 是工具、同事还是导师？

items.text: 我更希望 AI 教给我方法和思路，而不是替我把事做完。
items.text_en: I prefer AI to teach me methods and reasoning rather than just doing things for me.

items.text: 我希望 AI 分步骤展示进度，而不是一次性给出全部结果。
items.text_en: I want AI to show progress step by step rather than delivering everything at once.

items.text: 面对不确定的选择，我宁可多花时间确认，也不想事后返工。
items.text_en: When facing uncertainty, I'd rather take time to confirm than redo work later.

items.text: 解释概念时，一两个具体例子比抽象定义更有用。
items.text_en: A couple of concrete examples help me more than abstract definitions.

items.text: 我希望 AI 用结构化格式（列表、表格）组织信息。
items.text_en: I prefer AI to organize information in structured formats like lists or tables.

items.text: 对我来说，AI 更像是经验丰富但尊重我判断的同事。
items.text_en: For me, AI is like an experienced colleague who respects my judgment.

items.text: 我的工作以写代码为主。
items.text_en: My work is mainly coding.

items.text: 给出修改建议前，我希望 AI 先展示将要改变的内容。
items.text_en: Before suggesting changes, I want AI to show what it will modify.

items.text: 给 AI 布置任务时，目标说清楚即可，实现细节由 AI 自己把握。
items.text_en: When assigning tasks, I only need to state the goal; AI can handle the details.

items.text: AI 是一个工具，我应该掌握所有决策权。
items.text_en: AI is a tool; I should hold all decision-making authority.

items.text: 我希望 AI 主动发现并提出我没提到的问题。
items.text_en: I want AI to proactively raise issues I haven't mentioned.

items.text: AI 的答案听起来越确定，我越放心。
items.text_en: The more certain AI sounds, the more reassured I feel.

items.text: 比起委婉表达，我更喜欢直接了当的反馈。
items.text_en: I prefer direct feedback to diplomatic phrasing.

items.text: 我的工作以写作/文档为主。
items.text_en: My work is mainly writing or documentation.

items.text: 重大改动前，我希望有充分的验证和检查点。
items.text_en: Before major changes, I want thorough validation and checkpoints.

items.text: 探索性任务，AI 可以直接尝试，不必每一步都问我。
items.text_en: For exploratory tasks, AI can just try things without checking in at each step.

items.text: 我更喜欢正式的书面表达，而不是随意的聊天口吻。
items.text_en: I prefer formal written expression over casual chat tone.

items.text: 我的想法有明显缺陷时，我希望 AI 直接指出，而不是顺着我。
items.text_en: When my ideas have clear flaws, I want AI to point them out directly rather than agree.

items.text: 我习惯通过类比来理解新概念。
items.text_en: I tend to understand new concepts through analogies.

items.text: AI 的回复实用就好，不必讲究书面正式感。
items.text_en: AI replies just need to be useful; formality isn't necessary.

items.text: 为保证作答质量，这道题请选择“是”。
items.text_en: To ensure quality, please select "Yes" for this question.

items.text: 做重要决定时，我会追问 AI 的证据来源和可靠程度。
items.text_en: For important decisions, I ask AI about its evidence and reliability.

items.text: 我不喜欢 AI 给我没要求的额外建议。
items.text_en: I don't like AI giving me unsolicited extra suggestions.

items.text: 我希望 AI 使用准确的标点、完整的句子和规范的格式。
items.text_en: I want AI to use accurate punctuation, complete sentences, and proper formatting.

items.text: 同一类任务 AI 做过一次后，我希望它直接代劳。
items.text_en: After AI has done a task type once, I want it to just take over.

items.text: 我希望 AI 记住我的长期偏好和工作背景。
items.text_en: I want AI to remember my long-term preferences and work context.

items.text: 我享受尝试新的、未经检验的做法。
items.text_en: I enjoy trying new, untested approaches.

items.text: 我需要被认可，AI 应该多肯定我。
items.text_en: I need validation; AI should affirm me more.

items.text: 只要答案大致正确，我不在乎 AI 是否说明置信度。
items.text_en: As long as the answer is roughly correct, I don't care if AI states its confidence.

items.text: 解释问题时，抽象原理就够了，具体例子我自己能想出来。
items.text_en: Abstract principles are enough; I can come up with examples myself.

items.text: 如果我的做法有更优路径，我希望 AI 主动提出来。
items.text_en: If there's a better approach, I want AI to suggest it proactively.

items.text: 当 AI 不确定时，我希望它明确说“我不确定”，而不是自信地猜测。
items.text_en: When AI is uncertain, I want it to say so rather than guess confidently.

items.text: AI 只做我交代的事就好，不用多想。
items.text_en: AI should just do what I ask, no more.

items.text: 我经常在多个任务之间切换。
items.text_en: I often switch between multiple tasks.

items.text: 答案中细节过多会让我觉得信息过载。
items.text_en: Too many details in answers make me feel overloaded.

items.text: 新方法即使有风险，只要收益够大就值得尝试。
items.text_en: New methods are worth trying if the payoff is large enough, even with risk.

items.text: 遇到不熟悉的领域，我希望 AI 用通俗的说法把概念讲清楚。
items.text_en: In unfamiliar domains, I want AI to explain concepts in plain language.

items.text: 我总体上认为结构化、有条理的信息很重要。
items.text_en: Overall, I consider well-structured, organized information important.

items.text: 我偏好简洁的回复，不要过度展开。
items.text_en: I prefer concise replies without over-elaboration.

items.text: 我更喜欢严密的技术术语，而不是通俗化解释。
items.text_en: I prefer precise technical terms over plain-language explanations.

items.text: 我喜欢先看到整体框架，再进入细节。
items.text_en: I like to see the overall framework first, then go into details.

items.text: 重要决策应该由我做，AI 只负责提供信息。
items.text_en: Important decisions should be mine; AI just provides information.

items.text: 轻松、随意的语气让我感觉更自然。
items.text_en: A relaxed, casual tone feels more natural to me.

items.text: 任务完成后，AI 主动建议下一步是有价值的。
items.text_en: After a task, AI proactively suggesting next steps is valuable.

items.text: 常规、无风险的操作，AI 可以直接执行。
items.text_en: For routine, low-risk actions, AI can just proceed.

items.text: 我通常一次只专注做一件事。
items.text_en: I usually focus on one thing at a time.

items.text: 我的目标是尽快拿到结果，过程有没有学会不重要。
items.text_en: My goal is to get results quickly; learning the process doesn't matter.

items.text: 我更信任附有具体代码、数据和证据的回答。
items.text_en: I trust answers more when they include concrete code, data, and evidence.

items.text: 我愿意让 AI 参与讨论和权衡，而不是只听指令。
items.text_en: I'm open to AI participating in discussion and trade-offs, not just following orders.

items.text: 我希望 AI 区分“事实”和“推测”。
items.text_en: I want AI to distinguish between facts and speculation.

items.text: 涉及删除、重写或移动文件的操作，必须先得到我的明确同意。
items.text_en: Operations that delete, rewrite, or move files must have my explicit approval first.

items.text: 我倾向于在动手前把方案想透了，而不是边做边改。
items.text_en: I prefer to think through the plan fully before acting, rather than iterating as I go.

items.text: 我更习惯晚上/深夜工作。
items.text_en: I usually work better in the evening or late at night.

items.text: 我希望 AI 解释“为什么这样做”，而不只是“怎么做”。
items.text_en: I want AI to explain the "why," not just the "how".

items.text: 即使风险很低，我也希望 AI 动手前先说明它打算做什么。
items.text_en: Even with low risk, I want AI to state what it plans to do before acting.

items.text: 如果 AI 有不同的方案，应该先按我的方案来，再讨论。
items.text_en: If AI has a different approach, it should follow mine first, then discuss.

items.text: 我希望 AI 在合适时机主动给出自己的建议，而不只是执行。
items.text_en: I want AI to proactively share its suggestions at the right moments, not just execute.

items.text: 我宁可自己动手做，只要 AI 能及时纠正我。
items.text_en: I'd rather do it myself as long as AI corrects me promptly.

items.text: 我欢迎 AI 质疑技术方案，即使我最终可能坚持己见。
items.text_en: I welcome AI challenging my technical decisions, even if I ultimately stick with mine.
